definitions.intervention: Zero clinical embedding for image_only; zero both pooled image embeddings for clinical_only. Same trained multimodal weights; no retraining or baseline claim.
definitions.grouping: Original number of images per patient; single=1, multiple>1. No image-level sample counting.
definitions.macro_average: Only true-label-present classes contribute. Absent-class AUROC and undefined per-class ratios are null; macro precision uses zero for a present class never predicted, specificity skips undefined terms.
definitions.class_accuracy: accuracy_within_class is recall TP/(TP+FN); one_vs_rest_accuracy is (TP+TN)/N.
definitions.severity: Direct q evaluated only on true appendicitis. Gated severity includes diagnosis failures. End-to-end complicated is class 2 vs all other patients.
definitions.ci: Wilson 95% for binomial rates; patient bootstrap stratified by true three-class labels for selected aggregate metrics.
definitions.auprc: Average precision, not trapezoidal PR area. Brier multiclass sums squared errors over three classes.
definitions.calibration: Top-label ECE uses argmax probability/accuracy, not the hierarchical threshold decision.
